detail: Full summary: spec's default stakes formula is sign-inverted for its stated purpose (rewards HIGH confidence +0.3, so the lead reviews agents' most-confident irreversible decisions first, contradicting 'ranked by how expensive to get wrong'), exceeds its declared [0,1] range (max 1.1), and gives handoffs no term at all; combined with §4.2's contractual golden-test ordering in a published semver package this would freeze a wrong formula — resolve stakes-null vs advisory-ordering before v1
